'''Brank''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who was employed as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] confronted Xizor and the Black Sun [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Tyno Fabris]] inside Fabris' office in the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], after Xizor reneged on a deal to have Black Sun transport Pavan to [[Kantaros Station]] in the [[Both system]]. Xizor instructed Brank to stand guard, to forestall any possible attacks by Pavan. Xizor soon had his forces turn on Pavan, and the Falleen ordered Brank to defend him from the Jedi.
